name: updateSettings
description: Changes the plugin's settings, design or introduction screen, only those given.

followingEnabled.description: Whether app users can follow locations to hear about updates. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

allowCustomNotifications.description: Whether location editors can send notifications to a location's followers. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

defaultSorting.description: How locations are sorted at first. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

hideSorting.description: Whether app users are kept from changing the sorting. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

allowSortByReverseAlphabetical.description: Whether app users can sort from Z to A. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

allowSortByNearest.description: Whether app users can sort by distance; turning it off makes locations sort by name at first. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

allowSortByPriceLowToHigh.description: Whether app users can sort from cheapest. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

allowSortByPriceHighToLow.description: Whether app users can sort from priciest. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

allowSortByDate.description: Whether app users can sort from newest. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

allowSortByRating.description: Whether app users can sort by rating. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

allowSortByViews.description: Whether app users can sort by views. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

allowFilterByArea.description: Whether app users can show only the area on the map. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

allowFilterByBookmarks.description: Whether app users can show only their bookmarked locations. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

hideOpeningHoursFilter.description: Whether the open now choice is hidden. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

hidePriceFilter.description: Whether the price choice is hidden. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

distanceUnit.description: How distances are shown. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

showInitialArea.description: Whether the map opens on a chosen area. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

initialAreaAddress.description: The address of the area the map opens on. Leave it out to keep the current one, or leave it empty to remove it.

initialAreaLatitude.description: Where the map opens, north to south, from -90 to 90. Leave it out to keep the current one, or leave it empty to remove it.

initialAreaLongitude.description: Where the map opens, east to west, from -180 to 180. Leave it out to keep the current one, or leave it empty to remove it.

bookmarksEnabled.description: Whether app users can bookmark at all. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

allowBookmarkLocations.description: Whether app users can bookmark locations. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

allowBookmarkSearches.description: Whether app users can bookmark their searches. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

allowOpeningHours.description: Whether locations have opening hours; turning it off stops app users adding them. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

allowPriceRange.description: Whether locations have a price range; turning it off stops app users adding one. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

timeFormat.description: How opening hours are shown. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

listViewPosition.description: How far the list of locations opens over the map. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

listViewStyle.description: How locations look in the list. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

defaultMapType.description: How the map looks at first. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

enableMapTerrainView.description: Whether the map can show terrain. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

hideQuickFilter.description: Whether the category chips above the map are hidden. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

allowMapStyleSelection.description: Whether app users can switch the map style. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

showDetailsCategory.description: Whether a location's page shows its category and subcategory. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

showContributorName.description: Whether a location's page shows who added it. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

detailsMapPosition.description: Where the map sits on a location's page. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

introDescription.description: The formatted text on the introduction screen, as HTML. Leave it out to keep the current one, or leave it empty to remove it.

introSorting.description: How the introduction screen sorts its locations. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

introLocationsSource.description: Which locations the introduction screen shows. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

introAreaAddress.description: The address at the center of the local area the introduction screen shows. Leave it out to keep the current one, or leave it empty to remove it.

introAreaLatitude.description: The center of the local area, north to south, from -90 to 90. Leave it out to keep the current one, or leave it empty to remove it.

introAreaLongitude.description: The center of the local area, east to west, from -180 to 180. Leave it out to keep the current one, or leave it empty to remove it.

introAreaRadius.description: How far around its center the local area reaches, from 1 to 200 miles. Leave it out to keep the current one, or leave it empty to remove it.

introImages.description: The pictures at the top of the introduction screen, in order, each with its picture and what tapping it does. Replaces the current pictures. Leave it out to keep them, or pass an empty list to remove them.

callback.description: Runs when the settings are saved.

error.description: Why they weren't saved, such as nothing to change, or sorting by distance first while sorting by distance is off.

result.description: The settings, as they are now.
